<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS spectrum the most intense ion appears at m/z 262.099 Da, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.0073 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈261.092 Da. The formula that matches this exact mass most closely is C₁₁H₁₈O₇ (monoisotopic mass = 262.105 Da, [M+H]⁺ = 263.112 Da, within the typical experimental tolerance). Therefore the molecular formula of the molecule in the sample is:

**C11H18O7** 

<final_answer>C11H18O7</final_answer>
